title: Planzer parcel data breach, Nov 2026
also_called: the Digitec Galaxus delivery data leak

subject.name: Planzer
subject.about: Planzer is a family-owned Swiss transport and logistics company based in Seewen, Schwyz, with its operational headquarters in Dietikon near Zurich.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Planzer, Digitec Galaxus, Brack.ch, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Planzer says shipment data on every parcel sent with Planzer Paket over more than five years was taken, including orders from the online retailer Digitec Galaxus. No number of people has been given.
who_is_affected: People who sent or received a parcel through Planzer Paket between January 2018 and February 2023, including Digitec and Galaxus customers. Payment data was not taken. Be wary of messages about parcels that ask for personal or payment details.

known.text: Planzer says cybercriminals stole data on its customers' transport orders.
Digitec Galaxus says parcel numbers, names, delivery addresses, emails and some phone numbers from its orders were taken.
Planzer says payment and financial data were not affected; shippers' portal logins were taken in encrypted form and reset.
Switzerland's cybersecurity office and data protection commissioner have been told.

not_known.text: When the attack began and when it was found.
